users.bio: Poet, editor, and steward of creative sparks.

prompts.text: Write about a room that remembers your name.
Write a poem about a hope that sounds like rain.
A forgotten object begins speaking in a crowded train.
Describe a goodbye that happens without anyone leaving.
Write a letter to a version of yourself that has changed.
Describe the smallest choice that changed your direction.
Let two strangers recognize each other through one sentence.
Write about a promise kept long after the people who made it forgot.
Describe a city that only appears after midnight.
A garden grows from the place where a secret was buried.
Write about the last page of a book no one else has read.
A melody from your childhood returns with a different ending.
Write from the perspective of a key that opens no door.
Give your character one kindness they cannot explain.
Invent a festival held for something your world has lost.
Describe the rule every child learns before they can read.
Turn an ordinary grocery list into a confession.
Write a scene using only questions and gestures.
Tell an entire friendship in exactly six sentences.
Write a 50-word story that ends with an unlocked door.
